stem:
Sagar stands at $0$ on a number line. He first walks $7$ steps to the right, then $2$ steps to the left. He must mark each movement before he computes.

Which marking is correct?

options.text: Right $7$ as the mark $0$, then left $2$ as the mark $0$.
Both movements as $7$ and $2$ with no signs.
Both movements as $+7$ and $+2$, because every walk starts from $0$.

teacher.key_rationale: Rightward is positive and leftward is negative, so the moves are +7 then −2. Marking both as 0 swaps in the start-point label; dropping signs omits direction; treating both as positive because of the start at 0 confuses position with direction.
